title: pouteria dictyoneura subsp. fuertesii
intro: Pouteria dictyoneura subsp. fuertesii, commonly known as a medicinal plant, is a species within the family Sapotaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria dictyoneura subsp. fuertesii include the ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, which may contribute to its use in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
